draft_status: The author draft listed five accepted code/registry repairs marked not_final. None was executed before the author died. This adjudication defers all five as routed defects; it does not claim them.

accepted_now_as_corrections.correction: In the 43-row replay, the instrument supplies receipt argv, cwd and revision from the same values it executes, so they are equal by construction. The population verdict tests exit and stdout only. Argv discrimination is shown only by the source-read pair (1/ARGV_MISMATCH vs 0) and the synthetic cases.

The replay is not an isolated clone: pin-disposition-read and verify-round15 (external=true) read live fleet state, and the clone symlinks live sibling repos. The replay is 41 revision-pinned rows plus 2 live-dependent rows. No sibling write isolation is evidenced; replay.py writes its --out directory into the lane.

The gate binds bundle-declared requirements under the caller-owned expected digest. Freezing the requirement set before execution is enforced only by replay.py comparing two evidence-local files (requirements.json and registry-baseline.json). QUALITY46 narrowed by QUALITY47.
The receipts at 496d212 and the delivered gate are linked by tool content digest d533dc1e (identical at 496d212 and 336565f), not by matching revision labels.

The lesson Mistakes row 2 pointer route-mix-before.json:34/64 is a broken line anchor. The fact zai=34/64 is in line 3 (stderr). route-mix-final.json line 3 shows zai=25/64, so the rebalance is verified.

routed_not_executed.defect: A name-insensitive argv mutant (receipt argv in any requirement argv) is outside the ten-anchor sweep and would survive all 38 selftest cases [seat inference, not executed]. Needs a swapped-name supplemental case plus that mutant.
An unexecuted negative-exit guard-weakening candidate. Its expected survival is a seat inference, not a measured survivor.
The command-binding-frozen-clean and source-read-red registry rows do not pin bundle_sha256 literals, so a regenerated bundle and expected pair would still hold.
The replay projection drops the runner fields held, cleanup_ok, external and non_hermetic_argv. The receipt schema cannot carry a live-dependency marker.
runner_sha256 and instrument_sha256 hash the live-tree copy of registry-check.py, not the clone copy that ran. The values are equal at 496d212, 8f66b5d and 336565f.
replay.py compares sibling identity by string and does not take the realpath of the fleet root. This is latent for a non-canonical --repo; the actual run used the canonical path.
Replay streams are retained without size bounds or redaction. No secret was observed in the inspected rows.
Preexisting loose stdout substring tokens in frozen rows. They are kept unchanged by the no-retrofill/frozen-argv rule.

Text corrections keep the measured claim honest without new unreviewed code.
